candidate_repair: Replace spawn-only worker initialization with a pre-CUDA Linux fork/preload path while retaining four processes, four simultaneous official environments, one shared model, the same identities, seeds, launch offsets, FIFO requests, and actual-arrival logging.

best_case_bound.assumption: Give the candidate every favorable import-sharing benefit: five observed parent/worker LIBERO-Torch runtime copies collapse to one, saving four complete measured import increments. No private page is dirtied and no fork overhead is charged.
best_case_bound.caveat: This is a deliberately favorable capacity bound, not an executed full-path peak. It may double-count some WSL base residency, but the candidate has only 1.694 GB of idealized ceiling headroom versus a measured 6.923 GB model-active increment; eliminating all duplicated imports is therefore insufficient by several gigabytes.

safety_and_fidelity_audit.reason: Forking a live EGL/MuJoCo context is unsafe and would no longer provide four independently constructed official environment processes. Only pre-import pages could be shared safely, and their best-case savings are insufficient.
safety_and_fidelity_audit.reason_lower_concurrency_rejected: Either change replaces the preregistered actual-arrival four-shard schedule intervention and cannot be reported as the unchanged closed-loop gate.

reopen_condition: Use a clean scientifically equivalent host with at least 48 GB physical RAM under the unchanged zero-swap, no-offload, and 82% ceiling rules, or obtain explicit authority for a new independent lower-concurrency scientific protocol.
